name: P0 demo loaded
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;await h.actions();const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>s.n===4,150000,'demo steps');window.__installed=()=>{const l=window.__h.labels();const hdr=['METAL','CONCRETE','ROBOTIC'].map(x=>l.indexOf(x)).filter(i=>i>=0);const end=hdr.length?Math.min(...hdr):l.length;return l.slice(0,end)};return h.json(s)})()

name: P1 Workshop lists the demo's installed machines and the uninstalled metal, concrete and robotic sections
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;h.click('Workshop');await h.until(()=>h.find('Table Saw'),30000,'workshop rows');const inst=window.__installed();for(const m of ["Generic Saw", "Generic Drill", "Generic Attacher", "Circular Saw", "Table Saw", "Band Saw", "Chain Saw", "Drill Press", "CNC Router", "Doweling Jig", "Screw Gun"])h.ok(inst.includes(m),'installed '+m+' in '+h.json(inst));for(const m of ["Chop Saw", "Angle Grinder", "Pillar Drill", "Mag Drill", "Plasma Cutter", "MIG Welder", "Stud Welder", "Diamond Saw", "Wall Saw", "Wire Saw", "Core Drill", "Rotary Hammer", "Anchor Setter", "Surface Grinder", "6-Axis Robotic Mill", "5-Axis Gantry CNC", "Waterjet", "Laser Cutter", "Robotic Assembler"])h.ok(!inst.includes(m),'not yet installed '+m+' in '+h.json(inst));const l=h.labels();for(const g of ['METAL','CONCRETE','ROBOTIC'])h.ok(l.includes(g),'section '+g+' in '+h.json(l));return h.json(l)})()

name: P2 expanding the sections lists all 19 machines of the metal, concrete and robotic extensions
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;for(const g of ['METAL','CONCRETE','ROBOTIC']){if(!h.find('Chop Saw')||!h.find('Diamond Saw')||!h.find('Waterjet')){const b=h.find(g);if(b)b.click();await h.wait(700)}}const l=h.labels();const miss=["Chop Saw", "Angle Grinder", "Pillar Drill", "Mag Drill", "Plasma Cutter", "MIG Welder", "Stud Welder", "Diamond Saw", "Wall Saw", "Wire Saw", "Core Drill", "Rotary Hammer", "Anchor Setter", "Surface Grinder", "6-Axis Robotic Mill", "5-Axis Gantry CNC", "Waterjet", "Laser Cutter", "Robotic Assembler"].filter(m=>!l.includes(m));h.ok(!miss.length,'missing machines '+h.json(miss)+' in '+h.json(l));return h.json(l)})()

name: P3 installing Waterjet, Chop Saw and Diamond Saw through their Workshop rows moves them into the installed list
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;const done=[];for(const [g,m] of [['ROBOTIC','Waterjet'],['METAL','Chop Saw'],['CONCRETE','Diamond Saw']]){if(!h.find(m)){h.find(g).click();await h.until(()=>h.find(m),15000,'expand '+g)}h.find(m).click();await h.until(()=>window.__installed().includes(m),30000,m+' installed');done.push(m)}const inst=window.__installed();for(const m of ["Generic Saw", "Generic Drill", "Generic Attacher", "Circular Saw", "Table Saw", "Band Saw", "Chain Saw", "Drill Press", "CNC Router", "Doweling Jig", "Screw Gun"])h.ok(inst.includes(m),'demo machine kept '+m);return h.json([done,inst])})()

name: P4 Catalogue lists the capabilities of the newly installed machines
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;h.click('Catalogue');await h.until(()=>h.find('Generic Saw — Cut'),30000,'catalogue rows');const want=['Chop Saw — Chop','Waterjet — Jet Cut','Diamond Saw — Crosscut','Generic Saw — Cut','Table Saw — Rip'];await h.until(()=>{const t=document.body.innerText;return want.every(w=>t.includes(w))},30000,'catalogue rows '+h.json(want));return h.json(h.labels().filter(x=>x.includes(' — ')).slice(0,60))})()

name: P6 right-click the installed Waterjet row
P7 the context menu offers Remove
P8 click Remove in the context menu
P9 Waterjet is uninstalled while Chop Saw, Diamond Saw and the demo machines remain
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;const inst=await h.until(()=>{const i=window.__installed();return i.includes('Waterjet')?null:i},30000,'waterjet removed');for(const m of ['Chop Saw','Diamond Saw',...["Generic Saw", "Generic Drill", "Generic Attacher", "Circular Saw", "Table Saw", "Band Saw", "Chain Saw", "Drill Press", "CNC Router", "Doweling Jig", "Screw Gun"]])h.ok(inst.includes(m),'kept '+m+' in '+h.json(inst));h.ok(h.labels().includes('Waterjet'),'Waterjet returns to the uninstalled robotic section');return h.json(inst)})()

name: P10 Catalogue drops the Waterjet capability and keeps the other installed machines
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;h.click('Catalogue');await h.until(()=>h.find('Generic Saw — Cut'),30000,'catalogue');await h.until(()=>!document.body.innerText.includes('Waterjet — '),30000,'waterjet capability gone');const t=document.body.innerText;for(const w of ['Chop Saw — Chop','Diamond Saw — Crosscut','Generic Saw — Cut','Table Saw — Rip'])h.ok(t.includes(w),'catalogue keeps '+w);return 'ok'})()

name: P11 the document is unchanged apart from the workshop
